For [bytes](/docs/shell/commands/categories/bytes/).

<div class='command-title'>Reverse the bytes in the pipeline.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> bytes reverse {flags} ...rest```

## Parameters

 -  `...rest`: For a data structure input, reverse data at the given cell paths.


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| binary | binary |
| table  | table  |
| record | record |
## Examples

Reverse bytes `0x[1F FF AA AA]`.
```nu
> 0x[1F FF AA AA] | bytes reverse
Length: 4 (0x4) bytes | null_char printable whitespace ascii_other non_ascii
00000000:   aa aa ff 1f                                          ×××•

```

Reverse bytes `0x[FF AA AA]`.
```nu
> 0x[FF AA AA] | bytes reverse
Length: 3 (0x3) bytes | null_char printable whitespace ascii_other non_ascii
00000000:   aa aa ff                                             ×××

```
